name: Trigonometry Applications
roadmap: Move beyond right-angled triangles using the Sine and Cosine rules. Master the calculation of triangle areas using trigonometry. Explore real-world applications including Bearings and 3D figures, which are core topics for HKDSE Paper 1 Section B.
roadmap_zh: 使用正弦和餘弦定理超越直角三角形。掌握使用三角函數計算三角形面積。探索包括方位和三維圖形在內的實際應用，這些是香港中學文憑考試 (HKDSE) 卷一乙部的核心課題。

learning_modules.title: Non-Right-Angled Triangles & Applications
learning_modules.title_zh: 非直角三角形及其應用

concepts.name: The Sine Rule & Area
concepts.key_takeaway: Use the Sine Rule when you have an angle and its opposite side (AAS or SSA). The Area formula works for any triangle given two sides and the included angle (SAS).
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 當你有一個角及其對邊（AAS 或 SSA）時，使用正弦定理。面積公式適用於給定兩邊及其夾角（SAS）的任何三角形。

concepts.name: The Cosine Rule
concepts.key_takeaway: The Cosine Rule is your go-to for SAS (finding the third side) or SSS (finding any angle). It is used for acute and obtuse triangles alike.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 餘弦定理適用於 SAS（求第三邊）或 SSS（求任何角）。它同樣適用於銳角和鈍角三角形。

concepts.name: Bearings & 3D Angles
concepts.key_takeaway: True bearings are measured clockwise from North using 3 digits. In 3D, the angle between a line and a plane is the angle between the line and its projection on the plane.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 真方位是從正北順時針測量的 3 位數字。在三維空間中，直線與平面之間的夾角是直線與其在平面上的投影之間的夾角。
